cases.name: Lauren Bullis
cases.about:
She was a Department of Homeland Security employee. Family members describe Bullis as an avid runner who frequently shared her races online, with one relative calling her "such a special person."

A Department of Homeland Security press release said: "Lauren Bullis served in multiple roles at DHS Office of Inspector General (OIG). She served as an Auditor in the Office of Audits and as a Team Leader in the Office of Innovation. In every role she held, Lauren exemplified dedication to the OIG mission. Lauren approached her work with integrity, thoughtfulness, and a commitment to excellence that strengthened our organization and the communities we serve. Beyond her professional accomplishments, Lauren was a bright spot for so many of the DHS community. She brought warmth, kindness, and a genuine sense of care to her colleagues each day."
